pricing.title: How is your price calculated?
pricing.subtitle: The more volume accumulates in the pool, the lower the freight cost. The earlier you join, the bigger your discount.
pricing.inviteMessage: Know other importers? Invite them to the pool — more volume lowers the price for everyone, including you.
pricing.referenceNote2: Maximum reference price: {price}/m³. Your actual price will always be equal to or lower.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.step1Desc: Select the pool for your route and sign up. The earlier you join, the bigger your share of the savings generated.
howItWorks.step2Desc: As more importers join and volume crosses thresholds, the carrier cost drops and distributable savings increase for everyone.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Your price updates in real time based on current pool volume and the day you joined. You never pay more than the reference price.

transparency.title: Full transparency
transparency.desc: The reference price is the absolute ceiling any client will pay. Each client's actual price is calculated individually based on their entry day and accumulated pool volume.
transparency.point1: The reference price is the ceiling, not the actual price
transparency.point2: The earlier you join and the more volume there is, the bigger your savings
transparency.point3: Our commission is deducted from savings generated, not from the base price
